---
title: "Templates"
---

This appendix collects the reusable templates RIPLRT members use throughout a project's life. Copy a template into your project space and fill it in — don't edit the master here.

| Template | Use when | File |
|---|---|---|
| New Member Onboarding Checklist | Someone joins | [**New Member Onboarding Checklist**](/templates/new-member-onboarding-checklist.qmd) |
| Project Pod Charter | A project starts | [**Project Pod Charter**](/templates/project-pod-charter.qmd) |
| Individual Development Plan (IDP) | Each semester, per member | [**Individual Development Plan (IDP)**](/templates/individual-development-plan.qmd) |
| Student Research Plan | A student scopes a project | [**Student Research Plan**](/templates/student-research-plan.qmd) |
| Manuscript Planning Sheet | Before drafting a paper | [**Manuscript Planning Sheet**](/templates/manuscript-planning-sheet.qmd) |
| Authorship/Contributorship Agreement | Project start; updated as roles change | [**Authorship/Contributorship Agreement**](/templates/authorship-contributorship-agreement.qmd) |
| Data-Use & Access Checklist | Before touching project data | [**Data-Use & Access Checklist**](/templates/data-use-access-checklist.qmd) |
| GitHub Repository Checklist | New repo setup | [**GitHub Repository Checklist**](/templates/github-repo-checklist.qmd) |
| Reproducible Analysis Checklist | Before any submission | [**Reproducible Analysis Checklist**](/templates/reproducible-analysis-checklist.qmd) |
| AI-Use Disclosure Form | Any product with material AI assistance | [**AI-Use Disclosure Form**](/templates/ai-use-disclosure.qmd) |
| Conference Abstract Planning Sheet | Before an abstract deadline | [**Conference Abstract Planning Sheet**](/templates/conference-abstract-planning.qmd) |
| Weekly Meeting Agenda | Every pod meeting | [**Weekly Meeting Agenda**](/templates/weekly-meeting-agenda.qmd) |
| One-on-One Mentoring Meeting | Biweekly mentor↔mentee | [**One-on-One Mentoring Meeting**](/templates/one-on-one-meeting.qmd) |
| Stop/Start/Continue Feedback | Reviews and retrospectives | [**Stop/Start/Continue Feedback**](/templates/stop-start-continue.qmd) |
| Offboarding Checklist | Someone leaves | [**Offboarding Checklist**](/templates/offboarding-checklist.qmd) |
